description: Runs the Phase 16 retry application's original services and route handler against a disposable PostgreSQL database, one process per actor.

placeOrder.description: A `for` retry loop around a plain INSERT (no idempotency key).

recordPayment.description: The same loop around INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING keyed by the reused idempotency key.

withdraw.description: A `while` loop re-running a SERIALIZABLE transaction on SQLSTATE 40001.
